figurative_meaning_en: insult or mistreatment from an insignificant person
example_sentences_in_bangla: সেই ছোটলোকের কথায় মন খারাপ করো না, এটা তো চামচিকের লাথি।
তার কটূক্তি শুনে হাসলাম, কারণ এটা চামচিকের লাথির মতো নগণ্য।
example_sentences_in_english: Don't get upset by that nobody's words; it's just the kick of a sparrow.
I laughed off his insult because it was as insignificant as a sparrow's kick.
history: This proverb originates from the imagery of an elephant falling into mud and futilely kicking at a sparrow, symbolizing overreaction to something trivial.
note: The idiom draws from everyday rural observations in Bengali folklore.
